subject: Prep playbook: onsite briefing, slide ownership & pre-read deliverables
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@stratus.com>
Cc: Jason Wood <j.wood@stratus.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Prep playbook: onsite briefing, slide ownership & pre-read deliverables

Team / Sarah —

Thanks again for confirming the Shoreline workshop dates (Dec 14–15). I attached a quick agenda outline to get us moving. High level asks in this first pass:

- Confirm executive attendees from Stratus and any special AV/room needs.
- Identify slide owners for each agenda block (see outline, "owners" column).
- Share any exec-level pre-read or one-pager you want in the packet.
- Final slide deadline: EOD Dec 10 to allow deck QA and printing.

Sarah, if you can flag which pieces need to be included in the executive packet (one-pager vs. bios vs. tech appendix) that would help. Monica/Laura — can you take the product deep-dive and the deployment case study respectively? If you prefer to swap blocks, tell me by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: 20261201_agenda_outline.pdf (outline + suggested owners, 6 pages)

Also thinking: we'll produce a single consolidated deck + a 1–page executive brief for the Stratus execs. Production plan: internal QA on Dec 11, finalize assets Dec 12, send to vendor for printing Dec 13 morning.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@stratus.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep playbook: onsite briefing, slide ownership & pre-read deliverables

Ben —

I'll own the product deep-dive. I'll use the redwood_slide_template and will include 2 quick customer mini-case slides (KPI impact + architecture diagram). Uploading my rough slides to the Drive folder by EOD Dec 6.

Couple of asks for Sarah: can you share any customer-facing metrics or outcome statements we'd be allowed to quote (1–2 bullets)? If not, we'll keep it high level.

Attached: redwood_slide_template.pptx (brand template + notes).

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@stratus.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Wood <j.wood@stratus.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@stratus.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep playbook: onsite briefing, slide ownership & pre-read deliverables

Ben / Monica —

Thanks — confirmed: two Stratus execs (VP Eng: Greg Park; Head of Data: Priya Sethi). They'd like a brief "What success looks like" one-pager ahead of the session, plus attendee bios. We can provide a metrics blurb for the customer mini-case (we'll send a short paragraph by Dec 5).

Also note: AV request — please ensure room has HDMI + USB-C adapters and a confidence monitor for slides. We'll have one in-house engineer (Jason) on call for setup.

I attached an example exec brief we've shared internally so you can see the expected level of detail.

Attachments: exec-one-pager.docx

Best,
Sarah Lee
Director, Platform Eng
Stratus Systems
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@stratus.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep playbook: onsite briefing, slide ownership & pre-read deliverables

Great — thanks Sarah. Timeline update and next steps:

- Dec 5: Stratus provides metrics blurb (Sarah).
- Dec 6: Monica uploads draft slides.
- Dec 8: Laura uploads case study booth / customer story slides.
- Dec 10 EOD: Ben consolidates deck and runs internal QA.
- Dec 11 (AM): Exec brief + final deck circulated to both teams.

Laura — can you handle logistics for printed packets and bring a USB-C backup drive? We can also hand off printing to the vendor if you prefer — estimated print window Dec 13 morning, cost TBD.

Also adding two links: drive folder and the HubSpot deal for reference.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-prep-playbook, https://hubspot.com/deal/STR-2026-Q4-0917

—Ben
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@stratus.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep playbook: onsite briefing, slide ownership & pre-read deliverables

Ben —

I'll take the case study slides and coordinate printing. I'll confirm printer and cost by Dec 4 and will bring a USB-C stick + one printed packet per Stratus exec. I'll also stitch together the attendee bios into a single PDF and upload as attendee_bios.pdf.

Attachments: final_presentation_v3.pptx (placeholder — will be replaced with consolidated deck after QA), attendee_bios.pdf

Laura Bennett
Events & Field Ops
Redwood Inference
